name: Direct role-session ARN grant, one exact session (suite-2 test 33)
note: IAM-1204 / acceptance-suite-2 test 33. An S3 object policy grants an ASSUMED-ROLE SESSION principal (arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/IncidentResponder/session-2026-08) in the resource-owning account. The analyzer must identify this as ONE exact assumed-role session (role + session name) and MUST NOT collapse it to the underlying role ARN (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/IncidentResponder). With the explicit owning account (123456789012) equal to the principal's account, it is a direct SAME-ACCOUNT grant (RESOURCE-SAME-ACCOUNT-GRANT, medium) carrying the resource-vs-identity caveat, plus the session-specific note that same-account resource-policy grants to a session principal have distinct permissions-boundary / session-policy behavior. The session ARN is preserved verbatim in evidence; explicit denies remain applicable.

RESOURCE-SAME-ACCOUNT-GRANT: NOT collapsed to the underlying role
